verdict.rationale: kitty is a local terminal emulator. Its user data is mostly its plain-text kitty.conf configuration, which a user notes 'fits in a dotfiles repo'. Hands-on remote control also shows `kitten @ ls` dumping window, tab and layout state as JSON and `kitten @ get-text` reading terminal output back. There is no documented data-export or portability feature as such. missing for 10: a documented export of all user data (config, sessions, scrollback), explicit open-format portability guarantees, independent corroboration of migrating away.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
